title: fix(collapsible): stop honouring an authored `open`, then retire it on both faces (objectui#8236)
body:
Fixes #8236

`Clause-②: yes` — step 2 narrows a published accept set (`@object-ui/types`). Executes the
maintainer ruling on that card (director batch #144 item 4, 2026-09-17, 「9593 A,其他同意」):
**letter A, two steps, intercept before retire.** Drafted on purpose by the implementer seat — an at-tier contract review on the landing head was
the PM seat's to dispatch, and that seat did ⛔ not enqueue, ⛔ not mark ready, ⛔ not enable
auto-merge.

⚠️ **Past tense, deliberately.** The review has since run and returned **PASS**: an isolated
at-tier subagent, fed only the card, the ruling and this PR, measured at 85/85
`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` from its own transcript. The record of record is comment 5717059216 on this
PR; `check-clause2-carriers --pair 9699` then exited 0, both carriers were cleared in one stroke,
and the PM seat readied and enqueued from head `c48c4a101850d41e9e847757e3d62e1e2e41da27`.
⛔ This paragraph was rewritten before the enqueue because this repository's squash commit message
carries the full PR body **verbatim**, so 「does not enqueue」 would otherwise have landed in
`main`'s history as a false statement about the very commit carrying it.

## Per-step status

| step | what the ruling asked for | status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 — intercept | the collapsible registration stops forwarding `open` to Radix; ⛔ not via the global metadata strip list | **done** — a named exclusion (`open: _open`) in that one registration |
| 2 — retire | tombstone on both faces, PR objectui#7774 shape (member KEPT in the mirror so the parity key sets stay equal), refusal message verbatim from the ruling | **done** — `retirementTombstone` on the zod face, `?: never` on the TypeScript face |
| 3 — immediate, no grace | no dual-spelling window; ⛔ no docs row for `open`; ⛔ no sibling sweep | **done** — nothing added to `content/docs/components/disclosure/collapsible.mdx` (its interface block never listed `open`), and objectui#6158 / objectui#5667 / objectui#4631 are untouched here |

Order is load-bearing and both halves are in one commit: the render path runs no `safeParse`, so
retiring the declaration alone would have deleted the author's only warning while the takeover kept
running.

## Files in this diff — one row each

| file | what changed |
| --- | --- |
| `packages/components/src/renderers/disclosure/collapsible.tsx` | step 1. `open: _open` added to the registration's destructure so an authored `open` no longer rides `{...props}` onto the Radix root. Plus the comment that says why this is an ADDED exclusion and not a deleted forwarding statement, and why `onOpenChange` deliberately stays in the spread. |
| `packages/components/src/__tests__/collapsible-open-intercept-8236.test.tsx` | NEW. The behavioural pin: real `SchemaRenderer`, real registry, DOM readings, five controls, both polarities, plus the NOT-GATED leg that ties step 1 to step 2. |
| `packages/types/src/disclosure.ts` | step 2, TypeScript face. `open?: boolean` becomes `open?: never` with the retirement docblock. |
| `packages/types/src/zod/disclosure.zod.ts` | step 2, mirror face. The `z.boolean()` arm becomes `retirementTombstone(...)` carrying the ruling's message verbatim. |
| `packages/types/src/__tests__/collapsible-open-refusal-8236.test.ts` | NEW. The contract pin: membership, `invalid_type` at the key's own path, the message and its docs-surface twin, the remedy, positive controls, `onOpenChange` untouched, and the scope pin that `dialog` / `sheet` / `popover` still ACCEPT `open`. |
| `.changeset/8236-collapsible-open-intercept-retire.md` | `@object-ui/components` minor + `@object-ui/types` minor, with the 「Breaking for authored metadata」 note. `minor` not `major` per this repo's version policy. |

## The behavioural half — RE-MEASURED, not inherited

The card records this half as carried from another file's header and asks for a fresh reading. Taken
here on the branch point `bbe57fdd52bf69f993decba179a64dfc89b26e97`, through the real
`SchemaRenderer` and the real registry, one key varied per fixture, reading Radix's `data-state` on
the root and the content text in the tree.

**BEFORE (the branch point, takeover intact) — 5 legs, all green, i.e. the card's claim reproduces:**

| fixture | initial | after one trigger click | reading |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| bare (CONTROL) | closed | open | the instrument sees state move |
| `defaultOpen: true` (CONTROL) | open | closed | the published key works, both directions |
| `zzzNotAKey: true` (CONTROL) | closed | open | an unknown key moves nothing |
| `open: true` (TARGET) | **open** | **open** | trigger FROZEN |
| `open: false` + `defaultOpen: true` (TARGET) | **closed** | **closed** | `open` BEAT `defaultOpen`, trigger FROZEN |

**AFTER (this branch):**

| fixture | initial | after one trigger click |
| --- | --- | --- |
| bare (CONTROL) | closed | open |
| `defaultOpen: true` (CONTROL) | open | closed |
| `zzzNotAKey: true` (CONTROL) | closed | open |
| `open: true` (TARGET) | closed | open — and a second click closes it again |
| `open: false` + `defaultOpen: true` (TARGET) | open | closed |

The three controls read identically before and after; only the two target rows moved. The pin file
carries these plus `SPREAD_STILL_LIVE` (an unrelated authored key still reaches the root element, so
the exclusion is one key by name and ⛔ not a blanket strip) and `IDEMPOTENT` (the same node twice
reads identical, which is what makes the equality reading meaningful).

⇒ **the card's mechanism is confirmed as filed, and its own headline premise stays REFUTED**: `open`
was live, not inert.

## Route A's precondition — NOT GATED still holds on this head

| reading | result |
| --- | --- |
| non-test `safeParse` in `packages/react/src` | **0** |
| `from 'zod'` imports in `packages/react/src` | **0** |
| FIRING CONTROL — files matching `safeParse` under `packages/*/src` | **380** |
| FIRING CONTROL — files importing `from 'zod'` under `packages/types/src/zod` | **20** |
| runtime leg (in the new pin) | the mirror refuses the node, and the renderer paints that same node anyway |

⇒ no zod parse on the render path, which is exactly why step 1 had to land and why it had to land first.

## The `zod-mirror-parity` ledger row — MEASURED, not asserted

**Measurement:** with the tombstone symmetric on both faces, `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check`
(which is `tsc --noEmit` plus the examples program plus `tsconfig.test.json`, the program that
compiles `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`) exits **0**. ⇒ **no ledger row moves. `KnownDrift`,
`UnmirroredDeclared` and `RuntimeOnlyDeclared` are byte-untouched.**

**The firing control that makes that zero a reading** — the same instrument, with the pair
deliberately desynchronised, in BOTH directions:

| mutation | type-check exit | what the ledger said |
| --- | --- | --- |
| mirror reverted to `z.boolean()`, TS face left `?: never` | **2** | `Type '"disclosure.zod.ts#CollapsibleSchema"' is not assignable to type 'never'` and `Type '"open"' is not assignable to type 'never'` |
| TS face reverted to `open?: boolean`, mirror left tombstoned | **2** | `Type '"disclosure.zod.ts#CollapsibleSchema"' is not assignable to type 'never'` (a different row of the file from the leg above), plus `Unused '@ts-expect-error' directive` in the new types pin |

⇒ the ledger demonstrably reads this exact pair and this exact key, in both directions. The green
above is therefore a measurement of "nothing to record", ⛔ not an instrument that was never looking.

## Reverse verification

Every mutation below: predicted direction written first, mutation proved to have landed on disk by
counting the anchored text in both directions, restored with `git checkout HEAD -- PATH`, and the
restore proved by blob hash against the `HEAD` blob (⛔ not by an exit code). All three restores
came back byte-identical and `git diff HEAD` is empty for each path.

⚠️ No rebuild step is needed for these legs and none is implied: this repo's vitest config redirects
every package specifier to that package's `src`, and the TypeScript `paths` in the root `tsconfig.json`
map `@object-ui/types` to `packages/types/src`. Both instruments read SOURCE, so a stale `dist` cannot
make one of these legs falsely green.

| # | pin | mutation | predicted | observed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | the DOM pins (step 1) | remove `open: _open` from the registration | the takeover legs red, every control green | **5 failed / 7 passed** — `open: true` freeze, `open: false` beating `defaultOpen`, the equality leg, the full-cycle leg and the NOT-GATED leg all red; all five controls and both mirror legs green |
| 2 | the mirror pins (step 2) | revert the zod arm to `z.boolean().optional()` | the refusal legs red, membership green, parity type-check red | **4 failed / 9 passed** (parse, `invalid_type`, message, docs-surface twin) + type-check exit **2** naming the pair and the key |
| 3 | the TS tombstone (step 2) | revert the TS member to `open?: boolean` | parity type-check red, and the `@ts-expect-error` leg reported unused | type-check exit **2**, both diagnostics as predicted |

Blob hashes, before mutation and after restore: `00f193ba1…` / `00f193ba1…` (renderer),
`e76155bd2…` / `e76155bd2…` (mirror), `d352d1c3d…` / `d352d1c3d…` (TypeScript face).

## Authorship census — re-run on this head

The card's census was `open` **0/7** with firing control `trigger` **7/7**, taken at `72bcd7783`.
Re-run on `bbe57fdd5` the population has grown by one file, so the numbers are **not** the card's:

| reading | at `72bcd7783` (the card) | at `bbe57fdd5` (this branch point) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| lines matching the collapsible-node query | 8 in 6 files | **10 in 7 files** |
| of those, declaration-shaped (not authored nodes) | 1 | **2** — the discriminant in `packages/types/src/disclosure.ts` and, newly, the `interface` block inside the docs page, which is a documented declaration and not a node |
| authored collapsible nodes | 7 | **8** |
| `open` present | 0/7 | **0/8** |
| firing control `trigger` present | 7/7 | **7/8** |

The one node without `trigger` is the deliberate `@ts-expect-error` `children` fixture in
`packages/types/src/__tests__/content-channel-family-d-9256.test.ts`, which by construction carries
only `children` — so the control still fires wherever a real node exists. A whole-file sweep of every
file carrying an authored collapsible reads **0** `open` keys, against `defaultOpen` firing once in the
docs page. ⇒ nobody is standing on this key; the retirement breaks no in-repo document.

## Anchors re-derived on this head (⛔ not relayed)

| anchor | reading |
| --- | --- |
| `SchemaRenderer` metadata strip list, at the symbol `outgoingComponentProps` | **17** named keys, comments stripped |
| `open` on that list | **not present** (firing control: `testId` IS present; absent-token control reads 0) |
| the literal token `open` in the collapsible renderer at the branch point | **0** — the card's thesis, not a refutation of it |

every exit code was captured to disk BEFORE any pipe.

| `pnpm exec vitest run packages/components/` | **0** | 278 files, 2729 tests |

**Declared narrowing.** `pnpm lint` (whole farm) and `pnpm test` (whole repo) were ⛔ not run; the two
packages this diff touches were linted and tested in full instead, and CI runs the farm. Three pieces
of evidence, because a narrowing is only a measurement when all three are present:

1. the population is read from eslint's own output, not guessed: `--format json` reports **272** files

2. the counts above are those files, with per-file findings read from the same JSON — the only finding

## Pending-changeset claim re-read — `.changeset/7767-collapsible-trigger-union.md`

Asked for by the PM seat after the `changeset-claim-re-read` gate flagged that this entry names BOTH
files this diff edits. Read by paragraph, and answered with readings.

**Verdict: this diff falsifies NOTHING in that entry. No correction made, so its frontmatter, level
and package list are untouched — the entry's blob is `508d6c78c…` at the branch point, at this
branch's head and in the working tree, the same hash three times.**

| claim, by paragraph | reading that answers it | verdict |
| --- | --- | --- |
| headline — `trigger` declares the node array "its Zod mirror, its runtime and its own shipped default already accept" | the mirror arm `trigger: z.union(…)` reads 1 at the branch point and 1 here; the renderer's `renderChildren(schema.trigger)` reads 1 and 1; the live registry's `defaultProps.trigger` is an Array carrying the shipped object | **still true** |
| "widens from `string \| SchemaNode` to `SchemaNode \| SchemaNode[]` … a bare string trigger type-checks before and after" | a TYPE claim; `packages/types/src/__tests__/overlay-trigger-union-7081.test.ts` pins the bare-string and singular forms and its program is green in the `@object-ui/types` type-check above | **still true** |
| "The Zod mirror is untouched — `zod/disclosure.zod.ts` already spelled this key `z.union(…)`" | the subject is THIS KEY: of the 42 changed lines in the two named files, **2** mention `trigger` and both are prose inside my own comments; the firing control on the same diff reads **18** lines mentioning `open` | **still true** ⚠️ see the boundary note below |
| "`renderChildren`, whose `Array.isArray` branch has served the array form all along" | `packages/components/src/lib/utils.tsx` is not in this diff (`Array.isArray` reads 2 at the branch point and 2 here), and at runtime an ARRAY trigger renders its button — this is the fixture shape the new DOM pin uses throughout | **still true** |
| "that same registration's `defaultProps.trigger` ships as an array" | the registration's whole options object — `inputs` and `defaultProps` together — is **byte-identical** across this diff, hash `0d6ffd854…` on both sides; and read from the LIVE registry after `import '../renderers'`, `defaultProps.trigger` is `[{ type: 'button', label: 'Toggle', variant: 'outline' }]` | **still true** |
| "copying the renderer's own default into a typed document is no longer a type error" | that document rendered through the real renderer in the probe and painted its trigger | **still true** |
| "The docs page's `trigger` row follows the declaration" | `content/docs/components/disclosure/collapsible.mdx` is not in this diff and its interface block still reads `trigger: SchemaNode \| SchemaNode[]` | **still true** |
| closing paragraph — "the validator's accept set does not move" | scoped to the objectui#7081 family widening of `trigger`; this diff moves the accept set of a DIFFERENT key and declares that in its own entry | **still true** |

**The control that makes the table a measurement, not a reading of my own intentions.** Every runtime
row above was re-taken with the step-1 exclusion mutated back out (the takeover restored), and the
three reading sets came back **byte-identical** — registry inputs, `defaultProps.trigger`, both
rendering trigger forms, and the shipped-default document. ⇒ nothing this entry claims moves with my
change in either direction. The renderer file was restored and re-verified by blob hash
(`00f193ba1…`).

⚠️ **The one boundary worth the seat's eye, named rather than decided.** The sentence "The Zod mirror
is untouched" is key-scoped in its own paragraph (it is the evidence for the `trigger` claim), and
under that reading it survives — `trigger`'s arm in that file is byte-identical. A reader who takes it
as a statement about the FILE would read it differently once both entries publish into the same
CHANGELOG, because this card does touch that file, for `open`. ⛔ I did not rewrite anyone else's
declaration on my own reading of an ambiguity; if the seat reads it the second way, the repair is one
word ("this key's arm is untouched") and I will make it on request.

⚠️ **Not a falsification, but a real finding the probe turned up — reported, ⛔ not filed by me.**
A bare-STRING `trigger` (which the TypeScript face and the zod mirror BOTH accept — `safeParse`
reads `success: true`) does not render: the node lands in the renderer's error boundary,
"Component `collapsible` failed to render", because `CollapsibleTrigger` uses `asChild` and a string
is not a single element child. Firing control in the same run: the singular OBJECT trigger parses AND
paints its label. This is **pre-existing** — the same reading comes back with my change mutated out —
and it is ⛔ out of scope for this card, which the ruling scoped to one key. It is the objectui#8236
shape pointing the other way: a value both published faces admit, that the runtime cannot serve.
Dedupe words: `collapsible`, `trigger`, `asChild`, `bare string node`, `error boundary`.

## Acceptance notes

- **The order is the contract, not an implementation detail.** Step 2 alone is worse than doing
  nothing (the card's own words). Anyone tempted to split this PR must keep step 1 ahead of step 2.
- **⛔ Not the global strip list.** `open` stays live on `dialog` / `sheet` / `popover`; that is pinned
  in the new types test, and the `CHANNEL` control of
  `packages/components/src/__tests__/alert-dialog-footer-keys-liveness-7963.test.tsx` — which uses an
  authored `open` on an `alert-dialog` as its positive control — still passes unchanged in the
  components run above.
- **`onOpenChange` is untouched** and still rides the spread onto the Radix root, where it now fires
  for the uncontrolled toggling this restores. Its runtime-slot declaration and its
  `zod-mirror-parity` ledger entry are unchanged.
- **The refusal message is byte-verbatim from the ruling**, which is why it does not carry this
  card's number the way sibling tombstones carry theirs. The card number lives in the docblocks on
  both faces instead. Say the word and it becomes a superset string.
- **Noted, not filed — the collapsible root carries stringified schema attributes.** The DOM readings
  in this PR show the Radix root rendering `trigger="[object Object]"` and `content="[object Object]"`:
  the node's own slot keys ride the same rest-spread onto the element. It is pre-existing, unrelated to
  `open`, and ⛔ deliberately out of scope here — the ruling scoped step 1 to one key. Successor: the
  next card on this file, or whoever sweeps objectui#4631. Dedupe words: `collapsible`, `rest-spread`,
  `trigger attribute`, `object Object`, `slot key DOM leak`.
- **Noted, not filed — a citation that ages into the past tense.** `packages/types/src/zod/overlay.zod.ts`
  and `packages/types/src/__tests__/alert-dialog-footer-keys-refusal-7963.test.ts` both describe the
  spread channel as "the same channel that made `CollapsibleSchema.open` live". After this PR that is
  history, ⛔ not a live reading — the sentence stays TRUE about the channel and about `alert-dialog`,
  which is what those files are actually asserting, so nothing is repaired here and ⛔ no sweep is
  opened. Successor: whoever next edits those files, under AGENTS.md's opportunistic-repair rule.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么** —— 可折叠区块(collapsible)有一个对外声明的 `open` 开关。过去在 JSON 里写上它,
组件会被**永久锁死**:点击没反应、也不报错;写 `open: false` 还会压过你明确写的 `defaultOpen: true`。
这次做了两件事,顺序固定:① 渲染层不再把 `open` 交给底层组件,区块回到它自己已经公布的输入清单
(`defaultOpen` / `disabled` / `trigger` / `content` / `className`);② 把 `open` 从公开的 TS 接口和
zod 校验里**退役**(立墓碑,不是裸删),作者再写它会被**指名拒绝**并告诉他该写什么。

**为什么改** —— 这个键的另一半(状态变化回调)按全局政策被按名字拒绝,所以作者**结构上不可能**
让它正常工作:声明存在、校验通过、运行时接管、无处求救。全仓扫描:**没有任何一个页面在用它**
(8 个可折叠节点,命中 0;同批对照 `trigger` 命中 7),所以今天没有用户受影响,退役不打断任何现存文档。
顺序不能反的原因已实测:渲染路径根本不跑 zod 校验,只退役声明等于删掉作者唯一的警告、却留着接管。

**风险与代价(含回滚)** —— 风险面很小:改动集中在一个区块的注册函数和两处声明,同包全量测试、
文档类型门禁、注册表门禁全绿。代价是**收窄了一个已发布的公开接口**:任何写了 `collapsible.open`
的元数据从此会被拒收(它本来也是坏的)。回滚:revert 这一个 commit 即可,两步一起回退——⛔ 别只回退其中一步,
只留退役那一半会回到「比不改更糟」的状态。`dialog` / `sheet` / `popover` 上的 `open` 是**真实可用的**,
本 PR 没动它们,并且有断言钉住。

**你要做的** —— 这是草稿 PR,按受管流程它等的是一条**至层合约评审**(由 PM 席位派发),⛔ 本席不翻 ready、
不入队、不自合。您这边只需要在评审时确认一件事:**把 `open` 从已发布接口上拿掉**这个决定(您已在
批次 #144 第 4 项裁过 A),以及拒绝文案是否就用裁决原句。

Drafted by the `domain:spec` @ objectui implementer seat, session `session_01UanLVj6xvbS6puBCewLr8L` — written in the body prose because a footer does not reliably survive an edit.
